articles.title: Ajit Pawar releases joint manifesto: In Pimpri, both NCPs vow daily water supply, free Metro & bus services
articles.summary: NCP national president Ajit Pawar, while releasing the joint manifesto for the Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC) polls, promised voters a crucial change: ensuring daily water supply. This pledge aims to replace the existing system of intermittent water supply, addressing a significant civic issue ahead of the local elections. This election promise highlights the party's focus on essential public services.

articles.title: A Classic '60s Sci-Fi Show Is Perfect For Fans Of Apple TV's Pluribus
articles.summary: Vince Gilligan's new sci-fi series "Pluribus" presents an intriguing premise centered on a strange radio signal from space. This signal contains the blueprint for a mysterious virus, which Earth scientists inadvertently mishandle after its reception. The series explores the dramatic consequences stemming from this extraterrestrial contact and the human error in dealing with unknown cosmic elements, potentially offering insights into global preparedness.

articles.title: ISRO to kick off 2026 with launch of Earth Observation Satellite
articles.summary: ISRO is preparing to launch its PSLV-C62 mission, featuring the EOS-N1 Earth Observation satellite and 15 co-passenger satellites. This significant launch highlights India's growing space capabilities for monitoring Earth, crucial for national development and scientific research. It further demonstrates India's technological prowess on the global stage.
